  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3769,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 2 && r->vs == 2) r->resample = z->resample_row_hv_2_kernel;","note":"The decoder only has explicit support for 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2; other layouts should be rejected rather than reach generic handling."},
